name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Sales Analytics & CRM Pipeline Professional | Salesforce, Excel & Data-Driven Selling
summary: Sales analytics and CRM professional with 15+ years turning pipeline and performance data into decisions sales leadership can act on. Owns CRM systems in Salesforce and HubSpot, builds Excel and Power BI reporting for executive stakeholders, and develops data-backed recommendations that move deals forward.

Write SQL queries for Power BI data modeling and BigQuery/GA4 pulls, and analyze complex datasets to extract actionable insights and structured recommendations.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs to client leadership.
Managed multi-stakeholder accounts in HubSpot, translating performance data into strategic recommendations.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Managed 15-20 reseller partner accounts in Salesforce, analyzing partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn, retaining all but one (~94% retention).

bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets, while maintaining accurate CRM records for a high-value account portfolio.
Labeled and defined the CRM fields required for outbound sales and onboarding workflows, standardizing data capture across the team.
